sections.content: Natural future talk combines plans, predictions, wishes and conditions. A connected account may move between ir a + infinitivo, the simple future and the subjunctive.

items.spanish: Voy a salir temprano porque mañana tendré que trabajar.
items.english: I'm going to leave early because tomorrow I'll have to work.

items.spanish: Espero que el viaje sea tranquilo, aunque seguramente habrá algún retraso.
items.english: I hope the trip is calm, although there will surely be some delay.

items.spanish: Si todo sale bien, alcanzaremos la meta antes de que termine el mes.
items.english: If everything goes well, we'll reach the goal before the month ends.

items.spanish: Estamos a punto de empezar, pero todavía no sabemos cuánto durará el recorrido.
items.english: We're about to start, but we still don't know how long the journey will last.

sections.content: Choose the future form according to its function: intention, prediction, wish, condition or expected result.
